import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top products by total revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()

# 2. Sales distribution by customer age group
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(age_group_sales))
axes[0, 1].pie(age_group_sales.values, labels=age_group_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               startangle=90, colors=colors)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Payment method preferences
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(payment_counts)), payment_counts.values, 
               color=['#CD853F', '#DEB887', '#F4A460'])
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(payment_counts)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(payment_counts.index, rotation=0)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Payment Method Preferences', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, v in enumerate(payment_counts.values):
    axes[1, 0].text(i, v + 10, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in by size preference
size_takeaway = pd.crosstab(df['size'], df['is_takeaway'])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway = size_takeaway.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
x = range(len(size_takeaway))
width = 0.35

axes[1, 1].bar([i - width/2 for i in x], size_takeaway[0], width, 
               label='Dine-in', color='#A0522D')
axes[1, 1].bar([i + width/2 for i in x], size_takeaway[1], width, 
               label='Takeaway', color='#D2691E')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(size_order)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Orders', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Dine-in vs Takeaway by Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
